name: 35111 · Mc Calla, AL
findings: ZIP 35111 (Mc Calla) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35111 (Mc Calla) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35111 (Mc Calla) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
